claims.claim_text: The closure result is derived from content-bound evidence, exact executions and temporally separated publication anchors.
claims.decision_rule: PASS only when every required evidence node is content-bound and independently validated
claims.failure_rule: FAIL when evidence exists without semantic fit, execution identity, or complete temporal anchor binding
claims.not_applicable_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE only for a field explicitly outside the mission scope; never for required controls
